meta.label: CRU audit parse
meta.description: Stream the host audit logs ($DIP_HOME/run/audit/audit.log*) and roll up Compute Resource Usage (memory GB·h + CPU·h from LOCAL_PROCESS, $ from LLM_USAGE) per project / user / context.type. Runs as the dataiku service account so it can read the local audit dir regardless of webapp impersonation.

params.name: max_files
params.label: Max rotated files to read (0 = all)
